data.content: Plan APPROVED. Verified independently: knots really is binary-only (no src/lib.rs), the clippy --workspace and check-file-sizes.sh gaps are real, tarpaulin already runs --workspace so the new crate needs its own tests to clear the 95% gate, and the release scripts match Cargo.lock's 'knots' package name exactly so a member crate cannot shadow it. Three binding corrections for implementation: (1) use find -uid "$(id -u)", not -user, since GNU find's -user takes a name; (2) NEVER emit the collapsed form let root = workspace("x").path().to_path_buf() — the guard drops at end of statement and deletes the dir before the test body runs; bind ws to a live local, and have the step-7 guardrail reject the one-liner; (3) [workspace] members is redundant (Cargo auto-adds path deps), keep it only for legibility. Non-blocking: add a patch changeset for the reaper behaviour change, and keep each sweep commit independently green so bisect works.
